bugs.error_message: bacen/cached.py has forbidden import: from app.data.models import IndicatorHistory
bugs.root_cause: bacen/cached.py has SQLAlchemy-dependent imports — equivalent to fipe/cache.py. Not excluded by original EXCLUDED set.
bugs.fix: Added 'cached.py' to EXCLUDED set in scripts/sync_core.py

bugs.error_message: RuntimeError: Task got Future attached to a different loop — session-scoped async engine fixture in pytest-asyncio
bugs.root_cause: Session-scoped async fixture for engine creates asyncpg connection pool bound to setup event loop. Function-scoped tests use different event loops causing loop mismatch.
bugs.fix: Made `engine` a sync fixture using asyncio.run() + NullPool (no pool caching). Added asyncio_default_test_loop_scope = 'session' to pytest config.

bugs.error_message: asyncpg: cannot manually rollback from within an async with block — session fixture teardown
bugs.root_cause: async_sessionmaker context manager auto-handles close/rollback on exit. Explicit await s.rollback() inside the async with block caused asyncpg error.
bugs.fix: Removed explicit await s.rollback() from session fixture — rely on async_sessionmaker context manager.

bugs.error_message: pydantic ValidationError: DATABASE_URL missing — /version endpoint calls get_settings() in tests
bugs.root_cause: /version endpoint calls get_settings() which requires DATABASE_URL env var. Not set in test env.
bugs.fix: Set os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = dsn in db_url fixture (session-scoped) so it's available for all tests.

bugs.error_message: docker APIError 500: failed to pull redis:7-alpine — Docker Hub not reachable in WSL2
bugs.root_cause: WSL2 environment has intermittent Docker Hub connectivity issues. redis:7-alpine not locally cached.
bugs.fix: Changed testcontainers Redis image to redis:7 (locally available). CI (GitHub Actions) uses redis:7-alpine fine.
